title: Small and baseline-dependent predictive value of platelet count–volume interaction for elevated CRP across NHANES cycles
abstract: A source-frozen log platelet count × mean platelet volume interaction gave only a small, uncertain improvement for CRP>3mg/L in an independent NHANES cycle: deltaAUC +0.000340, paired95%CI [-0.000136,+0.000836]. Survey-weighted discrimination was slightly positive, but nonlinear-baseline and source-refit checks did not establish robust added prediction. Source n5225/1903 cases; target n5646/2012. Fivefold source deltaAUC +0.000015 with worse Brier; target AUC0.774452 versus0.774792. A bounded negative robustness test, not proof that platelet physiology lacks information. No clinical utility or global novelty claim.
